# Hazard Communication (HazCom) & GHS Training

> Hazard Communication (HazCom) & GHS Training: 3 self-paced online courses from $39.99. 100% online, certificate on completion, team pricing.

Self-paced online training from HAZWOPER OSHA Training, LLC (https://hazwoper-osha.com), part of Industrial Certified Training, LLC (https://ictraining.us/). Courses are 100% online and work on any device, with a certificate of completion as soon as the final exam is passed. Team pricing applies from 2 to 1,000 seats. Phone: 1-866-429-6742.

## Courses

- [Hazard Communication (HazCom) with the Globally Harmonized System (GHS) Training](https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-97): $39.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Federal OSHA Regulations 29 CFR 1910.1200. Enroll: https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=97. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-hazard-communication-with-ghs
- [Cal/OSHA Hazard Communication (HazCom) with GHS Training](https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-688): $59.99 per person, 2 hours, English and Spanish, certificate valid 36 months. In accordance with Title 8, California Code of Regulations, Section 5194. Enroll: https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=688. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/calosha-hazard-communication-hazcom-with-ghs-training
- [OSHA Toxic and Hazardous Substances Safety Training](https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/#course-458): $79.99 per person, 5 hours, English, certificate valid 12 months. Enroll: https://hazcom-ghs.onlinetrainingcourses.us/checkout?course=458. Full syllabus: https://hazwoper-osha.com/online-courses/osha-toxic-and-hazardous-substances-safety-training
